structured_checks.checks: The envelope requires exactly one scripts.ini Shutdown entry on the machine side and exactly one Logon entry on the user side, each name and parameter string matched against the flat capability arguments. Other sections (an empty Startup or Logoff, if GPME writes one) are recorded under the side's require prefix, not asserted: their presence is part of the scripts.ini shape this capability measures.

The user extension list must carry the Scripts CSE {42B5FAAE-...}; the tool half GPME pairs with it on the user side is deliberately unasserted and is read from the record's delta. The machine side asserts the R2-measured pair because the shutdown sheet is the same snap-in R2 measured on Startup.

Both version halves must move up (>), not by an asserted step: GPME's per-dialog bump has not been measured for two sheets in one session. The packed relation versionNumber = user*65536 + machine is asserted against both the GPT.INI-derived and the AD-read value.

No PowerShell entry is authored and the ordering dropdown is never touched, so both psscripts.ini sides must carry config_shape 'none' (true whether or not GPME writes the file); whether it writes one is recorded, not asserted.
